data.name: Lubica
data.gender_notes: Lubica is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic element ljubiti, meaning 'to love'. In Czech, Lubica means 'bringer of light' or 'radiant one'. The name Lubica carries the meaning “Light, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Lubica usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Lubica belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lubica total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: לוביקה
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נשי עובדה, חגיגה, כבוד, שלום
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם לוביקה נובע מראשי תיבות לוב-יש-כ בעברית, והוא קשור למושגי כבוד, חגיגה ושלום. בספר תהלים, 24:6, כבוד הוא 'לוב' של יהוה, ובספר תהלים, 29:11, 'לוב-יש-כ' מתאר כבוד ושלום של יהוה. בפולקלור היהודי, 'לוב' נושא כבוד של קדושה ושלום.

in_greek.name: Λουβική
in_greek.meaning: κατά το δόγμα, έμψυχο αγγέλιο, σωτηρία
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Λουβική προέρχεται από το Λουβίς, που σημαίνει 'κατά το δόγμα' ή 'κατά τη δόξα'. Η λέξη έμψυχο αγγέλιο σημαίνει 'αγγελία της σωτηρίας' και είναι συνδεδεμένη με την ελευθερία της σκέψης. Στον Βιβλικό λόγο, το έμψυχο αγγέλιο αναφέρεται ως το δώρο της Θείας Δόξας.

in_latin.name: Lubica
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lubica derivatur a radicibus Lub-Isch in lingua Latina, quae significat 'forma' seu 'forma Dei', et 'forma salutis'. In libro Psalmorum, 24:6, 'Lub' est gloria Domini, et in libro Psalmorum, 29:11, 'Lub-Isch' significat gloria et salus Domini. In folklore Christiano, 'Lub' est figura gloriae et salutis.

in_english.name: Lubica
in_english.meaning: form, divine form, form of salvation
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lubica originates from the Hebrew roots Lub-Isch, meaning 'form' or 'divine form', and 'form of salvation'. In the Bible, 'Lub' is the glory of God (Psalm 24:6), and 'Lub-Isch' signifies the glory and salvation of God (Psalm 29:11). In Christian folklore, 'Lub' is a figure of glory and salvation.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lubica holds significant cultural importance in the Slavic tradition, particularly among the Czech people. It is a beautiful and unique name, often given to girls in the Czech Republic. The name represents the deep-rooted Slavic values of love, warmth, and light.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Lubica embodies the idea of love and light as divine qualities. It serves as a reminder of the importance of loving oneself and others, and of the spiritual light that guides us through life. This name can be a powerful inspiration for those seeking to deepen their spiritual connection with the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Lubica is of Slavic origin, derived from the word "lubit" meaning 'to love'. In Christianity, this name symbolizes a deep and unwavering love for God and His teachings, as well as a compassionate and nurturing love for others. Lubica embodies the spirit of kindness, warmth, and selflessness, reflecting the divine love that inspires us all.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Lubica was a Slavic goddess of water, fertility, and love. The name Lubica carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: used as a given name for females
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Lubica is of Slavic origin and is derived from the Slavic goddess of water, fertility, and love. It is a beautiful and unique name that has gained popularity as a given name for females in various parts of the world.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Lubica, a minister in Jerusalem, Israel, shares that their name Lubica meaning "Light, Radiance" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
